notes.title: Two New Doll Traps!!
notes.content:
We have edited the two doll traps, lightning doll and headless doll, to have an effect on the game and the player. This year we will be releasing a good bit of new traps for Reiko and possibly a few new ghosts towards the latter half of this year! 

Below is the patch notes:

- Lightning Doll Update
- Headless Doll Update
- Fixed: Shrine bug that stopped players from winning when throwing the key Tori Gate
- Add the button E for the door locks on Desktop Mode
- Fixed: spawn at the shrine
- Fixed: pivot of some pickable objects 
- Fixed: light build error
- Fixed: esc menu (pause menu in-game)
- Changed lighting to game making lighting overall darker

notes.title: Reiko's Fragments now available for PC (No VR headset required.)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

I know it's been a while since we last updated, been quite the year to say the least, but the team has been developing some new features that you have been requesting. One particular requested feature that we've heard again and again, was Reiko's Fragments to be playable on PC with Keyboard and Mouse, no VR headset needed.

Well, do we have good news for you. [b]Reiko's Fragments is now available for PC[/b]. We are thrilled to release this update and expand the Reiko community. 

To quickly clarify any confusion, Reiko's is still a VR title, but for those who don't own a VR headset, can now play Reiko's as well. Also, any future updates will be available for both versions. 

We hope everyone has a safe and exciting Halloween!

Speaking of which, the Pixel team is excited to see people playing live over Halloween, you may never know, a Dev or two might just hop in your game and give a scare. ^ - ^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971501/a5fb192f1f3572af0219df664854bb65d5ffe47f.png[/img]

Stay Spooky -

notes.title: New Map Released - The Shrine
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=gIoMfmrOZaY;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Somewhere deep in the northern forests, lies a hidden shrine dedicated to the King of Hell.[/i]

[h3]Pixel Canvas Studios is excited to reveal Reiko's Fragments first major update - Shrine. [/h3]
Throughout the course of production, we had a lot of ideas we wanted to visit. The haunted house was a no brainer and wanted to established that map first before moving on to other ideas. Shrine was everything we were wanting to explore. An outside environment, weather elements, new design, and audio.  Everything fits so perfectly. When I say perfectly, I mean terrifying. 

Shrine is easily the most intense experience yet, that truly haunting experience when the Fog rolls across the map, unable to see around you, hearing the ghost walk towards you. That will get your heart panicking every time. 

This is a [b]Free [/b]update and will be available on December 19th. 

To learn more, [url=https://www.pixelcanvasstudios.com/blog/2019/12/13/new-map-the-shrine]please visit here[/url] to see the full details of the Shrine map.

tags.feature: Pixel Canvas Studios is excited to reveal Reiko's Fragments first major update - Shrine.

notes.title: Server Maintenance: 11/24/19, from 12AM-1AM PST (8AM-9AM GMT)
notes.content:
We are performing server maintenance from 12AM - 1AM PST (8AM - 9AM GMT) 
on November 24th 2019.

The changes include:
[list][*] Improved server stability.
[*] Improvements to the spectator web UI.
[*] Addition of a quit button to the web UI. 
[/list]
 
Mobile / Web Players:
[list][*] These changes  will REQUIRE you to restart your currently active game if you are in one during the update period. 
[*] If, when you enter reikovr.com, you are in a game; you can use the quit button to exit out of that game.
[/list]
